cards.title: Calculating with results
cards.body: Built-in functions give back values, so you can use them straight away in a calculation.

cards.title: Inside out
cards.body: Python works out `max(...)` and `min(...)` first, then applies the operator between their results.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: max is 10 and min is 3, so 10 - 3 is 7.
